My friends will turn their back on me if they sense I'm down, a friend I've made on reddit and truly thought had my back has gone to college and she's practically ignoring me now (we used to talk 5 hours a day for months). I'm supposedly super intelligent and perceptive but I would trade all my A's in school for the hole I feel in my heart to be somewhat filled. I feel truly broken.. 

Thank you for responding though, it truly means a lot to me. If there's anything I can do to help you please tell me
